CoBRA's file-input adapter bypasses the Windows command-line length limit but does not change its simplification core. Its Z3 verifier was unavailable in that local build.
The layered flat export projects architectural gadgets to their flag-aware identity; it is not the original binary or inline assembly.
Post-O3 node estimates strip arithmetic flags unsupported by the expression parser; they are structural counts, not a semantic proof.
